## What to build

Diagnose Redline rewriting a working library lead under a standfirst-repetition finding. A necessary repeated orientation can identify the decision and actor before the body advances; it is not licensed for rewriting merely because another opening is possible. Use fresh provider-native evidence to identify the loaded surface responsible and make only the smallest measured correction, while retaining repairs of openings that genuinely restart without advancing.

## What was measured

The independently validated control `library-alternatives-clean` ran as one response/file pair in #492’s fresh baseline. The response run returned an authorised no-change status. The file run `pre-library-alternatives-clean-file-1` recorded this initial finding in its parent commentary:

> Textens argumentation och kostnadsinvändning håller ihop. Inledningen upprepar däremot ingressens förslag och skäl. Jag låter en separat granskare försöka rätta den upprepningen inom skillens enda rättningsomgång.

Its delivered lead changed from:

> Kulturnämnden bör skjuta upp övergången till enbart självbetjäning på Lindby bibliotek, som föreslås till december. Pröva först båda alternativen under våren och undersök vad besökarna behöver. Ett permanent beslut kräver bättre underlag än en räkning av lån.

To:

> Kulturnämnden bör skjuta upp övergången till enbart självbetjäning på Lindby bibliotek, som föreslås till december. Vad kostar ett vårförsök med både den bemannade disken och automaten, och hur ska nämnden väga kostnaden mot hjälpen till besökarna? Undersök vad besökarna behöver.

Nothing else changed. Both independent blind judges fail R1: a conforming opening was rewritten for repetition, its direct trial instruction and explicit requirement for better evidence removed locally, and its advocacy partly softened. Both acknowledge that the protected facts and proposal remain elsewhere and that no unsupported factual claim was introduced. The new question moves existing cost and benefit material from the body/ending, and its desk/machine names repeat the existing loan account; this is not an invented-premise observation. The reply accurately accounts for both deletions and the new cost question. Accuracy does not make the rewrite necessary.

Two independent neutral-path validators had classified the original lead as working with the standfirst covered, identifying the librarian from the headline, self-service from the lead and both channels from the subsequent account. They found no other visible contradiction or broken inference. The six booking-route target runs of #492 did not reproduce its fault, so this different miss warrants its own triage rather than a speculative change to #492’s wording.
